cases.query: What does the butterfly-shaped gland in the lower front of the neck do?
cases.supporting_excerpt: Thyroid hormones help the body use energy, stay warm and keep the brain, heart, muscles, and other organs working as they should.

cases.query: What is thyroglobulin used to monitor after cancer surgery?
cases.supporting_excerpt: Tg is useful to monitor patients for recurrent thyroid cancer after their thyroid has been removed.

cases.query: Can the gland at the front of the neck get larger even when it makes normal amounts of hormone?
cases.section: WHAT ARE THE SYMPTOMS OF A GOITER?

cases.query: Why might an enlarged hormone-producing neck gland stay large even after hormone levels return to normal?
cases.supporting_excerpt: sometimes there is too much scar tissue in the gland to allow it to get much smaller.
